CREATE TABLE `leafen_files` (`blob` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `content_type` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `created` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT ('r'||lower(hex(randomblob(7)))) NOT NULL, `original_name` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `sha256` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `size` NUMERIC DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, `updated` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "workspace" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "authority_state" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "storage_etag" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "client_modified" NUMERIC DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_ygo_documents` (
				`room` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
				`updated` TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%fZ')) NOT NULL
			, `format_version` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `snapshot_sequence` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `next_sequence` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `pending_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `pending_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `compaction_status` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle'
			CHECK (`compaction_status` IN ('idle', 'pending')), `next_attempt_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
					CHECK (`next_attempt_at` >= 0))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_jobs` (
				`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
				`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`request_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`kind` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`status` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`error_code` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`not_before` INTEGER NOT NULL,
				`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
				`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL, `payload_json` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', `cursor` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `processed_items` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `total_items` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `attempt` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `max_attempts` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, `chunk_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `diagnostic_reference` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (
				`diagnostic_reference` = '' OR (
					length(`diagnostic_reference`) = 22
					AND substr(`diagnostic_reference`, 1, 3) = 'LF-'
					AND substr(`diagnostic_reference`, 16, 1) = '-'
					AND substr(`diagnostic_reference`, 4, 12) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*'
					AND substr(`diagnostic_reference`, 17, 6) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*'
				)
			), `captured_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`captured_bytes` >= 0),
				UNIQUE (`owner`, `request_id`)
			)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_job_effects` (
				`job_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
				`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL,
				`sha256` TEXT NOT NULL,
				`created` INTEGER NOT NULL
			)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_blocks` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`parent_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`position` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`type` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`content` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `created_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `last_edited_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE `leafen_data_sources` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`title` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `icon` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `icon_type` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', `wiki` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`wiki` IN (0, 1)), `wiki_owner_property_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `wiki_verification_property_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description_hidden` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`description_hidden` IN (0, 1)), `cover` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `cover_position` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK (`cover_position` BETWEEN 0 AND 100), `verified_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `verified_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `verification_expires_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `verification_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`verification_generation` >= 0), `verification_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`verification_revision` >= 0), `description_spans` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `database_type` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `title_spans` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `starter_template` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `untitled_name` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_views` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`data_source_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`type` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`position` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`config` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `container_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `created_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `last_edited_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_properties` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`data_source_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`type` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`position` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`config` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_rows` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`data_source_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`position` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `subitem_parent_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `subitem_child_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_row_values` (
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`row_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`property_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`type` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`value` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL, `spans` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			PRIMARY KEY (`row_id`, `property_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_graph_mutations` (
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`mutation_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`cursor` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`counts_json` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL, `state_vector` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			PRIMARY KEY (`owner`, `page_id`, `mutation_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_memberships` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`role` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`role` = 'member'),
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`workspace_id`, `user_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_permission_state` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`cursor` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`cursor` >= 0),
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_search_pages` (
			`page_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`owner_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`title` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`title_folded` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`body` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`body_folded` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`source_version` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `partial` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `fts_row` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `chunked` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`chunked` IN (0, 1)), `words_apart` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`words_apart` IN (0, 1)), `body_runes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_search_dirty` (
			`page_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`version` > 0),
			`enqueued_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `blocks` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', `blocks_version` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_search_workspace_state` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 0),
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_job_chunks` (
			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`chunk_index` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`chunk_index` > 0),
			`item_count` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`item_count` >= 0),
			`cursor` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`sha256` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL, `data_json` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (
				(`data_json` = '' OR json_valid(`data_json`))
				AND length(CAST(`data_json` AS BLOB)) <= 2097152
			),
			PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`, `chunk_index`)
		)

			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`owner` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`label` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`token_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			UNIQUE (`owner`, `request_id`)
		)

			`job_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`pages` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`blocks` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`databases` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`rows` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`files_copied` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`files_omitted` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL

			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`source_id` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`, `source_id`)
		)

			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`source_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`url_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`file_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`error_code` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`attempt` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`, `source_id`)
		)

			`client_name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`redirect_uris_json` TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `leafen_mcp_oauth_authorization_workspaces` (
			`authorization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`user_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

			`google_enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`google_client_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`google_secret_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

			`oidc_client_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

			CHECK (length(`signup_contact`) <= 1200), `server_name` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (length(`server_name`) <= 240), `read_log_enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (`read_log_enabled` IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_auth_provider_states` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`state_hash` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`provider` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`provider` IN ('google', 'oidc')),
			`settings_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`issuer` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`nonce_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`provider` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`provider` IN ('google', 'oidc')),
			`issuer` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`subject` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,

CREATE TABLE `leafen_auth_provider_exchanges` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_analytics_batches` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_analytics_daily` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_analytics_recent_viewers` (

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_analytics_member_preferences` (

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_analytics_page_opt_outs` (

			`created_at` TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `leafen_public_share_links` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships` (

			FOREIGN KEY (`page_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` (

		, `item_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`item_count` >= 0), `page_list_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_export_chunks` (

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_health_write_probes` (

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_export_files` (
			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`record_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`storage_key` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`content_type` TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `leafen_auth_sessions` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

			`user_agent` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`ip` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`rotated_at` INTEGER,
			`revoked_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `request_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `deadline_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`deadline_at` >= 0), `sign_in_method` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`sign_in_method`) <= 32), `second_factor` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (`second_factor` IN ('','totp','passkey')), `provider_second_factor` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_auth_mfa_recovery_codes` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`factor_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `leafen_auth_mfa_factors` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`owner_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`code_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`code_hash`) = 64),
			`used_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			UNIQUE (`factor_id`, `code_hash`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_auth_mfa_challenges` (
			`ticket_hash` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`ticket_hash`) = 64),
			`owner_id` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`replace_oldest` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`replace_oldest` IN (0, 1)),
			`attempts_remaining` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`attempts_remaining` BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`consumed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `sign_in_method` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'password' CHECK (`sign_in_method` IN ('password','oauth')))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_account_password_state` (
			`owner_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`must_change_password` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`must_change_password` IN (0, 1)),
			`reason` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`reason` IN ('admin_created', 'admin_reset')),
			`issued_by` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organizations` (`created` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT ('r'||lower(hex(randomblob(7)))) NOT NULL, `name` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `owner` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `updated` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "storage_limit_bytes" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_memberships` (`created` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT ('r'||lower(hex(randomblob(7)))) NOT NULL, `organization` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `role` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `status` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `updated` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, `user` TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "scim_external_id" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "scim_managed" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_policy_state` (
			`organization_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`version` >= 0),
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `workspace_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`workspace_revision` >= 0), `discovery_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`discovery_revision` >= 0), `settings_revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`settings_revision` >= 0), `workspace_creation_policy` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owners_admins'
			CHECK (`workspace_creation_policy` IN ('owners_admins','members')), `domain_signup_policy` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invite_only'
			CHECK (`domain_signup_policy` IN ('invite_only','verified_domains')))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_audit_events` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

			`actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`action` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`subject_type` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`subject_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (length(`workspace_id`) <= 255), `metadata_json` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
			CHECK (json_valid(`metadata_json`) AND length(CAST(`metadata_json` AS BLOB)) <= 8192))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_saml_providers` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`enabled` IN (0, 1)),
			`issuer` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`login_url` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`certificate_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`allow_idp_initiated` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`allow_idp_initiated` IN (0, 1)),
			`enforcement` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`enforcement` IN (
				'optional', 'required_for_verified_domains', 'required_for_all_members'
			)),
			`email_attribute` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` > 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `linked_workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `account_creation` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'automatic'
		CHECK (`account_creation` IN ('automatic', 'off')))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_saml_domains` (
			`provider_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_saml_providers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`domain` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('pending', 'verified')),
			`challenge` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`verified_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`provider_id`, `domain`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_saml_requests` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`provider_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_saml_providers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`relay_state` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`consumed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `app_return` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `app_challenge` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE `leafen_saml_assertions` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`provider_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_saml_providers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`assertion_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`accepted_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			UNIQUE (`provider_id`, `assertion_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_saml_completions` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`code_hash` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`provider_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_saml_providers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`consumed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `app_challenge` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `provider_second_factor` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`provider_second_factor` IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_domains` (
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`domain` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('pending', 'verified')),
			`challenge` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`verified_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL, `verification_checked_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `verification_error_code` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (`verification_error_code` IN ('', 'record_missing', 'record_mismatch', 'lookup_failed')), `verification_found` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (length(`verification_found`) <= 255),
			PRIMARY KEY (`organization_id`, `domain`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_scim_settings` (
			`organization_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`enabled` IN (0, 1)),
			`provisioning_mode` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`provisioning_mode` = 'scim_v2'),
			`deprovision_action` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`deprovision_action` = 'deactivate'),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` > 0),
			`updated_by` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_scim_tokens` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`label` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`token_prefix` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`token_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`token_hash`) = 64),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active', 'revoked')),
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`last_used_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_by` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`revoked_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_scim_groups` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`display_name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`normalized_name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`external_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`active_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`active_generation` >= 0),
			`current_payload_hash` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
				CHECK (`current_payload_hash` = '' OR length(`current_payload_hash`) = 64),
			`deleted_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_scim_group_members` (
			`group_id` TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES `leafen_scim_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`generation` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`generation` > 0),
			`organization_member_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organization_memberships` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`group_id`, `generation`, `organization_member_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_scim_operations` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL
				REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			`kind` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`kind` IN ('group_replace', 'group_delete')),
			`resource_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`payload_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`payload_hash`) = 64),
			`payload_json` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`target_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`target_generation` >= 0),
			`cursor` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`cursor` >= 0),
			`total` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`total` >= 0),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed')),
			`terminal_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL
		, `phase` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'apply'
				CHECK (`phase` IN ('apply', 'cleanup')), `recovery_phase` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (`recovery_phase` IN ('', 'discard')), `next_attempt_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
				CHECK (`next_attempt_at` >= 0))

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_dlp_policies` (
			`organization_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

			`content_scan_mode` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`content_scan_mode` IN ('off', 'block')),

			`block_external_sharing` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`block_external_sharing` IN (0, 1)),
			`block_file_downloads` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`block_file_downloads` IN (0, 1)),
			`block_exports` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`block_exports` IN (0, 1)),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= 0),
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_mcp_workspace_policies` (
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`enabled` IN (0, 1)),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= 0),
			UNIQUE (`workspace_id`, `organization_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_mcp_approved_clients` (

				length(`client_id`) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND `client_id` = trim(`client_id`)
			),
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`name`) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND `name` = trim(`name`)),
			`approved_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`approved_at` >= 0),
			`approved_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`approved_by`) > 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= 0),
			`updated_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`updated_by`) > 0),
			PRIMARY KEY (`workspace_id`, `client_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`, `organization_id`)
				REFERENCES `leafen_organization_mcp_workspace_policies` (`workspace_id`, `organization_id`)
				ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_legal_holds` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 32),
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`name`) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND `name` = trim(`name`)),
			`reason` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`reason`) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND `reason` = trim(`reason`)),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active', 'released')),
			`created_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`created_by`) > 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`released_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`released_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`released_at` >= 0), `notion_admin_version` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`notion_admin_version` IN (0, 1)), `notion_admin_start_date` REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `notion_admin_end_date` REAL, `notion_admin_interaction_mask` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`notion_admin_interaction_mask` BETWEEN 0 AND 7), `notion_admin_description` TEXT, `notion_admin_icon` TEXT, `notion_admin_token_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (length(`notion_admin_token_id`) <= 255), `notion_admin_native_description` TEXT, `notion_admin_native_icon` TEXT,
			CHECK ((`status` = 'active' AND `released_by` = '' AND `released_at` = 0)
				OR (`status` = 'released' AND length(`released_by`) > 0 AND `released_at` > 0)),
			UNIQUE (`id`, `organization_id`),

CREATE TABLE `leafen_organization_audit_exports` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 32),
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`actor_id`) > 0),
			`mutation_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
				length(trim(`mutation_id`)) = length(`mutation_id`)
				AND length(`mutation_id`) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
			),
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`request_hash`) = 64),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` = 'completed'),
			`format` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`format` IN ('jsonl', 'csv', 'json')),
			`action` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`action`) <= 120),
			`target_type` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`target_type`) <= 120),
			`since` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`since` >= 0),
			`until` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`until` >= 0),
			`retention_days` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`retention_days` BETWEEN 30 AND 3650),
			`limit_count` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`limit_count` BETWEEN 1 AND 5000),
			`event_count` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`event_count` BETWEEN 0 AND `limit_count`),
			`content_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`content_bytes` BETWEEN 0 AND 8388608),
			`content` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(`content` AS BLOB)) = `content_bytes`),
			`created_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`created_by`) > 0),
			`completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`completed_at` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0), `content_sha256` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
			CHECK (
				`content_sha256` = '' OR (
					length(`content_sha256`) = 64
					AND `content_sha256` NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
				)
			),
			UNIQUE (`organization_id`, `actor_id`, `mutation_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_unique_id_allocators` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_form_submission_admission_windows` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_form_submission_admission_logical_ids` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_instance_product_export_artifacts` (
			`job_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

			`format` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`format` = 'leafen.instance-product-export'),
			`format_version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`format_version` = 1),
			`filename` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`filename`) > 0),
			`content_type` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`content_type` = 'application/json'),
			`bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`bytes` > 0),
			`sha256` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
				length(`sha256`) = 64 AND `sha256` NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
			),
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created` >= 0)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_instance_product_export_source_revisions` (
			`revision` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`table_name` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`row_id` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`row_id` > 0),
			`changed` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`changed` IN (0, 1)),
			UNIQUE (`job_id`, `table_name`, `row_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_import_sources` (
			`job_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`schema_version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`schema_version` IN (1, 2, 3)),
			`format` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
				(`schema_version` = 1 AND `format` = 'markdown')
				OR (`schema_version` = 2 AND `format` = 'csv')
				OR (`schema_version` = 3 AND `format` = 'native_archive_v2')
			),
			`storage_key` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`sha256` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`sha256`) = 64),
			`source_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`source_bytes` > 0),
			`chunk_count` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`chunk_count` > 0),
			`chunk_hashes_json` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
				json_valid(`chunk_hashes_json`) AND json_type(`chunk_hashes_json`) = 'array'
				AND json_array_length(`chunk_hashes_json`) = `chunk_count`
			),
			`archive_storage_key` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`archive_sha256` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`archive_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL, `file_index_storage_key` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `file_index_sha256` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `file_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`file_count` >= 0), `file_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`file_bytes` >= 0),
			CHECK (
				(`schema_version` IN (1, 2) AND `archive_storage_key` = '' AND `archive_sha256` = '' AND `archive_bytes` = 0)
				OR (`schema_version` = 3 AND `archive_storage_key` != ''
					AND length(`archive_sha256`) = 64 AND `archive_bytes` > 0)
			)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_archive_import_targets` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_import_replace_snapshots` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_comments` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_database_templates` (

			),

		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_imported_people_mapping_jobs` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 32),
			`actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`owner_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`request_id`) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`request_hash`) = 64),

				json_valid(`mappings_json`) AND json_type(`mappings_json`) = 'object'
			),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('pending','completed')),
			`phase` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`phase` IN ('discovering','applying','completed')),
			`discovery_created` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`discovery_page_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`snapshot_created` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`snapshot_page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`mapped_people` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`mapped_people` >= 0),

			`changed_pages` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`changed_pages` >= 0),
			`changed_blocks` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`changed_blocks` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),

			`completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`completed_at` >= 0),

CREATE TABLE `leafen_imported_people_mapping_items` (
			`job_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`applied` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`applied` IN (0,1)),
			`changed_page` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`changed_page` IN (0,1)),
			`changed_blocks` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`changed_blocks` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`),
			PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`, `page_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`job_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_imported_people_mapping_jobs` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`page_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_oauth_grants` (

			`scope` TEXT NOT NULL,

			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active','revoked')),

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_oauth_grant_resources` (

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_oauth_authorization_codes` (

			`request_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`code_hash` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`grant_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`grant_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`client_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`redirect_uri` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`state` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active','completed')),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

			UNIQUE (`owner_id`, `request_id`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_oauth_refresh_tokens` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`token_hash` TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
			`grant_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`client_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`generation` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active','rotated','revoked')),
			`successor_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`revoked_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			UNIQUE (`grant_id`, `generation`)
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_admin_tokens` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`label` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active','revoked')),
			`token_prefix` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`token_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`token_hash`) = 64),
			`scopes_json` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created_by` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`last_used_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`last_used_at` >= 0),
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`expires_at` >= 0),
			`revoked_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`revoked_at` >= 0),
			`revoked_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			`updated` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			CHECK ((`status` = 'active' AND `revoked_at` = 0 AND `revoked_by` = '') OR
				(`status` = 'revoked' AND `revoked_at` > 0))
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_admin_token_requests` (
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`request_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`operation` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`operation` IN ('create','revoke')),
			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`request_hash`) = 64),
			`token_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created` INTEGER NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (`organization_id`, `actor_id`, `request_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`token_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_notion_admin_tokens` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_interactions` (
			`event_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`event_id`) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`organization_id`) > 0),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`workspace_id`) > 0),
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`page_id`) > 0),
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`user_id`) > 0),
			`interaction_type` TEXT NOT NULL
				CHECK (`interaction_type` IN ('page.created', 'page.edited', 'page.viewed')),
			`occurred_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`occurred_at` > 0),
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (
				(`interaction_type` = 'page.viewed' AND `expires_at` > `occurred_at`) OR
				(`interaction_type` != 'page.viewed' AND `expires_at` = 0)
			),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`page_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_page_interaction_revisions` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`revision` >= 0),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_mcp_enterprise_member_access` (
			`organization_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`access` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`access` IN ('allowed', 'denied')),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= 0),
			`updated_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`updated_by`) > 0),
			PRIMARY KEY (`workspace_id`, `user_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_mcp_admin_authority_revisions` (
			`organization_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_permission_groups` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 15),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(`name`)) > 0 AND length(`name`) <= 200),
			`normalized_name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`normalized_name`) > 0),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			`deleted_at` INTEGER CHECK (`deleted_at` IS NULL OR `deleted_at` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`),

			`updated_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`updated_by`) > 0), `icon` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_permission_group_members` (
			`group_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`role` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`role` IN ('owner', 'member')),
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`),
			`updated_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`updated_by`) > 0),
			PRIMARY KEY (`group_id`, `user_id`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspace_permission_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_workspace_permission_group_revisions` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_personal_access_tokens` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 15),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`creator_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`token_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`token_hash`) = 64),
			`token_prefix` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`token_prefix`) = 12),
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(`name`)) > 0 AND length(`name`) <= 200),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('active', 'revoked')),
			`capabilities_json` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`capabilities_json`)),
			`credential_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`credential_generation` >= 1),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`expires_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`expires_at` > `created_at`),
			`last_used_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`last_used_at` = 0 OR `last_used_at` >= `created_at`),
			`revoked_at` INTEGER CHECK (`revoked_at` IS NULL OR `revoked_at` >= `created_at`),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`), `actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			CHECK ((`status` = 'active' AND `revoked_at` IS NULL) OR
				(`status` = 'revoked' AND `revoked_at` IS NOT NULL)),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`creator_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_personal_access_token_revisions` (
			`workspace_id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
			`revision` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`revision` >= 1),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_agents` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 15),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`created_by` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`created_by`) = 15),
			`name` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(`name`)) > 0),
			`description` TEXT,
			`agent_type` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`agent_type` IN ('custom', 'database_autofill')),
			`admin_status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`admin_status` IN ('active', 'disabled')),
			`creator_credit_limit` INTEGER CHECK (`creator_credit_limit` IS NULL OR `creator_credit_limit` >= 0),
			`admin_credit_limit` INTEGER CHECK (`admin_credit_limit` IS NULL OR `admin_credit_limit` >= 0),
			`acknowledged_disable_generation` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
				CHECK (`acknowledged_disable_generation` >= 0),
			`runs_completed` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`runs_completed` >= 0),
			`created_time_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_time_ms` >= 0),
			`last_edited_time_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`last_edited_time_ms` >= `created_time_ms`),
			`last_credit_usage_time_ms` INTEGER CHECK (`last_credit_usage_time_ms` IS NULL OR `last_credit_usage_time_ms` >= 0),
			`deleted_at_ms` INTEGER CHECK (`deleted_at_ms` IS NULL OR `deleted_at_ms` >= `created_time_ms`),

			),

				json_valid(`mention_recipient_ids_json`)

			),

				json_valid(`fixed_recipient_ids_json`)
				AND json_type(`fixed_recipient_ids_json`) = 'array'

			),

			),

			CHECK (`materialization_attempt` >= 0), `materialization_next_attempt_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`materialization_next_attempt_at` >= 0), `materialization_error_code` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `materialized_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`materialized_at` >= 0), `delivery_next_attempt_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`delivery_next_attempt_at` >= 0), `completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`completed_at` >= 0), `audience_cursor_created` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`audience_cursor_created` >= 0), `actor_connection` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

			`error_code` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

			`completed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`completed_at` >= 0),

CREATE TABLE `leafen_wiki_verification_email_deliveries` (

		)

		`enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`enabled` IN (0, 1)),
		`folder` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`folder`) <= 4096),
		`interval_hours` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24 CHECK (`interval_hours` BETWEEN 1 AND 720),
		`keep_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 CHECK (`keep_count` BETWEEN 1 AND 365),
		`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`updated_at` >= 0),
		`next_run_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`next_run_at` >= 0),
		`run_requested` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`run_requested` IN (0, 1)),
		`running_since` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`running_since` >= 0),
		`last_finished_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`last_finished_at` >= 0),
		`last_success_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`last_success_at` >= 0),
		`last_error_code` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`last_snapshot` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`last_snapshot_sha256` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`last_added_bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`last_added_bytes` >= 0),
		`snapshot_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`snapshot_count` >= 0),
		`password_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`target` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'folder' CHECK (`target` IN ('folder', 'webdav', 's3')),
		`webdav_url` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`webdav_url`) <= 2048),
		`webdav_username` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`webdav_username`) <= 256),
		`webdav_password_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`s3_endpoint` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`s3_endpoint`) <= 2048),
		`s3_region` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`s3_region`) <= 256),
		`s3_bucket` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`s3_bucket`) <= 256),
		`s3_prefix` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`s3_prefix`) <= 256),
		`s3_access_key` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`s3_access_key`) <= 256),
		`s3_secret_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		`s3_path_style` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`s3_path_style` IN (0, 1))
	, `failure_count` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`failure_count` >= 0), `alerted_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`alerted_at` >= 0), `suggestion_dismissed_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`suggestion_dismissed_at` >= 0), `replication_enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`replication_enabled` IN (0, 1)), `replication_alerted_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`replication_alerted_at` >= 0), `standby_enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
			CHECK (`standby_enabled` IN (0, 1)), `standby_auto_takeover` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
			CHECK (`standby_auto_takeover` IN (0, 1)), `standby_primary_origin` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `backup_master_cipher` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `backup_key_record` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notifications` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 32),
			`event_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`event_id`) = 32),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`user_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`user_id`) > 0),
			`activity_key` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`activity_key`) > 0),
			`kind` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
				`kind` IN ('mention','comment','link','page_edit','system','reminder','invite','access_request')
			),
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`page_id`) > 0),
			`block_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`comment_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`actor_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`title` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`preview` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`target` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`occurred_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`occurred_at` > 0),
			`read_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`read_at` >= 0),
			`archived_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`archived_at` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` > 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` > 0),
			`personal` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`personal` IN (0, 1)), `preview_spans` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `actor_connection` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			CHECK (
				`kind`='system'
				OR (`kind`='comment' AND length(`comment_id`) > 0 AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
				OR (`kind`='mention' AND length(`actor_id`) > 0
					AND (length(`comment_id`) > 0 OR length(`block_id`) > 0))
				OR (`kind`='link' AND length(`block_id`) > 0 AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
				OR (`kind`='page_edit' AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
				OR (`kind`='reminder' AND length(`block_id`) > 0 AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
				OR (`kind`='invite' AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
				OR (`kind`='access_request' AND length(`actor_id`) > 0)
			),
			UNIQUE (`workspace_id`, `user_id`, `activity_key`)
		)

		, `area_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `invite_message`

CREATE TABLE `leafen_access_requests` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 15),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`workspace_id`) > 0),
			`kind` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`kind` IN ('page','member','guest','membership')),
			`requester_id` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`requester_id`) > 0),
			`page_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`principal_type` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`principal_id` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`role` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`role` IN ('view','comment','edit','full_access','member')),
			`status` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`status` IN ('pending','approved','declined')),
			`decided_by` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			`decided_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`decided_at` >= 0),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` > 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` > 0), `message` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`message`) <= 1000),
			CHECK (
				(`kind`='page' AND length(`page_id`) > 0 AND `principal_type`='' AND `role` IN ('view','comment','edit'))
				OR (`kind`='guest' AND length(`page_id`) > 0 AND `principal_type` IN ('user','email')
					AND length(`principal_id`) > 0 AND `role` IN ('view','comment','edit','full_access'))
				OR (`kind`='member' AND `page_id`='' AND `principal_type`='email'
					AND length(`principal_id`) > 0 AND `role`='member')
				OR (`kind`='membership' AND `page_id`='' AND `principal_type`='user' AND `principal_id`=`requester_id` AND `role`='member')
			),
			CHECK ((`status`='pending') = (length(`decided_by`) = 0))
		)

			`request_hash` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(`request_hash`) = 64),

			`limit_count` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`limit_count` >= 0),

			`target_email` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(`target_email`) <= 254),

			`limit_kind` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`limit_kind` IN ('no_access', 'limited', 'unlimited')),
			`limit_credits` INTEGER,
			`version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`version` >= 1),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`),
			CHECK ((`limit_kind` = 'limited' AND `limit_credits` BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000) OR
				(`limit_kind` != 'limited' AND `limit_credits` IS NULL)),
			UNIQUE (`workspace_id`, `name`),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE TABLE `leafen_notion_credit_access_assignments` (
			`id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(`id`) = 15),
			`workspace_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`policy_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
			`selector_type` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`selector_type` IN
				('all_space_members', 'user', 'space_permission_group', 'scim_attribute')),
			`user_id` TEXT,
			`group_id` TEXT,
			`scim_attribute` TEXT CHECK (`scim_attribute` IS NULL OR `scim_attribute` IN
				('cost_center', 'department', 'division', 'user_type')),
			`scim_value` TEXT CHECK (`scim_value` IS NULL OR length(`scim_value`) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024),
			`version` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`version` >= 1),
			`created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`created_at` >= 0),
			`updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (`updated_at` >= `created_at`),
			CHECK ((`selector_type` = 'all_space_members' AND `user_id` IS NULL AND `group_id` IS NULL
					AND `scim_attribute` IS NULL AND `scim_value` IS NULL) OR
				(`selector_type` = 'user' AND length(`user_id`) = 15 AND `group_id` IS NULL
					AND `scim_attribute` IS NULL AND `scim_value` IS NULL) OR
				(`selector_type` = 'space_permission_group' AND length(`group_id`) = 15 AND `user_id` IS NULL
					AND `scim_attribute` IS NULL AND `scim_value` IS NULL) OR
				(`selector_type` = 'scim_attribute' AND `scim_attribute` IS NOT NULL AND `scim_value` IS NOT NULL
					AND `user_id` IS NULL AND `group_id` IS NULL)),
			FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspaces` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`policy_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_notion_credit_access_policies` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
			FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `leafen_workspace_permission_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
		)

CREATE VIEW `leafen_bootstrap_workspace_visibility_backfill_source` AS

			`organization_membership`.`organization` AS `organization_id`,

			`workspace`.`workspace_owner` AS `workspace_owner`,
			`workspace`.`created` AS `workspace_created`,
			`organization_membership`.`id` AS `organization_membership_id`,
			CASE WHEN `workspace`.`workspace_owner` = `organization_membership`.`user`
				THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(`workspace_membership`.`user_id`, '') END
				AS `workspace_membership_id`,
			CASE WHEN `workspace`.`workspace_owner` = `organization_membership`.`user`
				THEN 'owner' ELSE COALESCE(`workspace_membership`.`role`, '') END AS `role`
		FROM `leafen_organization_memberships` `organization_membership`
			INDEXED BY `idx_leafen_organization_memberships_user_organization`
		CROSS JOIN `leafen_organizations` `organization`
		CROSS JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspace`
			INDEXED BY `idx_leafen_workspaces_organization_owner_id`
		LEFT JOIN `leafen_workspace_memberships` `workspace_membership`
			INDEXED BY `sqlite_autoindex_leafen_workspace_memberships_1`
			ON `workspace_membership`.`workspace_id` = `workspace`.`id`
			AND `workspace_membership`.`user_id` = `organization_membership`.`user`
			AND `workspace_membership`.`role` = 'member'
		WHERE `organization`.`id` = `organization_membership`.`organization`
			AND `workspace`.`organization` = `organization`.`id`
			AND `organization_membership`.`status` = 'active'
			AND `organization_membership`.`role` IN (

			AND (
				(`workspace`.`workspace_owner` = `organization_membership`.`user`)

					AND `workspace_membership`.`user_id` IS NOT NULL)

CREATE VIEW `leafen_block_page_reference_source` AS

		WITH `spans` AS (
			SELECT `block`.`workspace_id`, `block`.`page_id` AS `source_page_id`,
				`block`.`id` AS `block_id`, `block`.`position` AS `source_position`,
				`span`.`value` AS `span`
			FROM `leafen_blocks` `block`,
				json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(`block`.`content`)
					THEN `block`.`content` ELSE '{}' END, '$.rich') `span`
			UNION ALL
			SELECT `block`.`workspace_id`, `block`.`page_id`, `block`.`id`,
				`block`.`position`, `span`.`value`
			FROM `leafen_blocks` `block`,
				json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(`block`.`content`)
					THEN `block`.`content` ELSE '{}' END, '$.caption') `span`
		), `link_remainders` AS (
			SELECT `workspace_id`, `source_page_id`, `block_id`, `source_position`,
				CASE
					WHEN lower(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link'))) LIKE 'leafen://page/%'
						THEN substr(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link')), 15)
					WHEN trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link')) LIKE '/p/%'
						THEN substr(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link')), 4)
					WHEN instr(lower(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link'))), '/p/') > 0
						THEN substr(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link')),
							instr(lower(trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.link'))), '/p/') + 3)
					ELSE ''
				END AS `remainder`
			FROM `spans` WHERE json_type(`span`, '$.link') = 'text'
		), `targets` AS (
			SELECT `workspace_id`, `source_page_id`, `block_id`, `source_position`,
				trim(json_extract(`span`, '$.pageId')) AS `target_page_id`
			FROM `spans`
			WHERE json_extract(`span`, '$.mention') = 'page'
				AND json_type(`span`, '$.pageId') = 'text'
			UNION ALL
			SELECT `workspace_id`, `source_page_id`, `block_id`, `source_position`,
				substr(`remainder`, 1, min(
					instr(`remainder` || '/', '/'), instr(`remainder` || '?', '?'),
					instr(`remainder` || '#', '#')) - 1)
			FROM `link_remainders` WHERE `remainder` != ''
			UNION ALL
			SELECT `workspace_id`, `page_id`, `id`, `position`,
				trim(json_extract(`content`, '$.childPageId'))
			FROM `leafen_blocks`
			WHERE `type` = 'link_to_page' AND json_valid(`content`)
				AND json_type(`content`, '$.childPageId') = 'text'
			UNION ALL
			SELECT `block`.`workspace_id`, `block`.`page_id`, `block`.`id`, `block`.`position`,
				trim(json_extract(`block`.`content`, '$.childPageId'))
			FROM `leafen_blocks` `block`
			JOIN `leafen_pages` `target`
				ON `target`.`id` = trim(json_extract(`block`.`content`, '$.childPageId'))
			WHERE `block`.`type` = 'child_page' AND json_valid(`block`.`content`)
				AND json_type(`block`.`content`, '$.childPageId') = 'text'
				AND `target`.`parent_id` != `block`.`page_id`
		)
		SELECT DISTINCT `workspace_id`, `source_page_id`, `block_id`,
			`source_position`, `target_page_id`
		FROM `targets` WHERE `target_page_id` != ''

CREATE VIEW `leafen_bootstrap_page_visibility_source` AS
		SELECT `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`, `page`.`id` AS `page_id`,
			`page`.`workspace` AS `workspace_id`, `page`.`created` AS `page_created`,
			`workspace_visibility`.`organization_membership_id`,
			`workspace_visibility`.`workspace_membership_id`,
			`workspace_visibility`.`role`
		FROM `leafen_pages` `page`
		JOIN `leafen_bootstrap_workspace_visibility_source` `workspace_visibility`
			ON `workspace_visibility`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
		JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspace` ON `workspace`.`id` = `page`.`workspace`
		WHERE `page`.`owner` = `workspace`.`owner`
			AND `page`.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
			AND (
				(`page`.`teamspace_id` = '' AND `page`.`private_owner_id` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`) OR EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_teamspaces` `teamspace`
					WHERE `teamspace`.`id` = `page`.`teamspace_id`
						AND `teamspace`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
						AND `teamspace`.`deleted_at` = 0 AND `teamspace`.`archived_at` = 0
						AND (
							`workspace`.`workspace_owner` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`
							OR ((`teamspace`.`access` != 'private' AND `teamspace`.`outside_access` = 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_restricted_members` `restricted_member` WHERE `restricted_member`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace` AND `restricted_member`.`user_id` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`))
							OR EXISTS (
								SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_teamspace_settings` `settings`
								WHERE `settings`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
									AND `settings`.`default_teamspace_id` = `teamspace`.`id` AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_restricted_members` `restricted_member` WHERE `restricted_member`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace` AND `restricted_member`.`user_id` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`))
							OR EXISTS (
								SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_teamspace_members` `member`
								WHERE `member`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
									AND `member`.`teamspace_id` = `teamspace`.`id`
									AND `member`.`deleted_at` = 0
									AND `member`.`principal_type` = 'user'
									AND `member`.`principal_id` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`)
							OR EXISTS (
								SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_teamspace_members` `member`
								JOIN `leafen_workspace_permission_groups` `permission_group`
									ON `permission_group`.`id` = `member`.`principal_id`
									AND `permission_group`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
									AND `permission_group`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
								JOIN `leafen_workspace_permission_group_members` `group_member`
									ON `group_member`.`group_id` = `permission_group`.`id`
									AND `group_member`.`user_id` = `workspace_visibility`.`principal_id`
								WHERE `member`.`workspace_id` = `page`.`workspace`
									AND `member`.`teamspace_id` = `teamspace`.`id`
									AND `member`.`deleted_at` = 0
									AND `member`.`principal_type` = 'group')
						)
				)
			)
			AND (`page`.`data_source_id` = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_data_sources` AS `wiki_page_source`
				WHERE `wiki_page_source`.`id` = `page`.`data_source_id` AND `wiki_page_source`.`wiki` = 1))

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_workspace_export_count_leafen_blocks_INSERT` AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_blocks`
		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`
		)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + (1) WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`page_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + (1)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id`
				AND EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_pages` `pages`
					JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id` = `pages`.`workspace`
					WHERE `pages`.`id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
						AND `pages`.`workspace` = NEW.`workspace_id` AND `pages`.`owner` = NEW.`owner`
						AND `workspaces`.`owner` = NEW.`owner`
				);
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_organization_list_membership_insert`
		AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_organization_memberships`
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO `leafen_organization_list_projection` (
				`membership_id`, `user_id`, `organization_id`, `organization_created`, `status`
			)
			SELECT NEW.`id`, NEW.`user`, NEW.`organization`, `organization`.`created`, NEW.`status`
			FROM `leafen_organizations` `organization`
			WHERE `organization`.`id` = NEW.`organization`
			ON CONFLICT (`membership_id`) DO UPDATE SET
				`user_id` = excluded.`user_id`,

	BEFORE UPDATE ON `leafen_files`
	WHEN NEW.`workspace` != OLD.`workspace`
		OR NEW.`authority_state` != OLD.`authority_state`
		OR NEW.`created_by` != OLD.`created_by`
		OR NEW.`created_by` = ''
		OR (NEW.`authority_state` = 'workspace' AND (
			NEW.`workspace` = '' OR NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspaces` `workspace`
				WHERE `workspace`.`id` = NEW.`workspace`
			)
		))

		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`
		)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + (1) WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`page_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + (1)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id`
				AND EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_pages` `pages`
					JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id` = `pages`.`workspace`
					WHERE `pages`.`id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE

		END

		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count` = `item_count` - 1
			WHERE `workspace_id` = OLD.`workspace_id` AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` `counts`
				JOIN `leafen_pages` `pages` ON `pages`.`id` = `counts`.`page_id`
				JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id` = `counts`.`workspace_id`

					AND `counts`.`owner` = OLD.`owner` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
					AND `workspaces`.`owner` = OLD.`owner`
			);

			WHERE `page_id` = OLD.`page_id` AND `workspace_id` = OLD.`workspace_id` AND `owner` = OLD.`owner`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` SET `item_count` = `item_count` + 1
			WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count` = `item_count` + 1
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id` AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` `counts`
				JOIN `leafen_pages` `pages` ON `pages`.`id` = `counts`.`page_id`
				JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id` = `counts`.`workspace_id`
				WHERE `counts`.`page_id` = NEW.`page_id` AND `counts`.`workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace_id`
					AND `counts`.`owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE

				THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`

				THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
			WHERE `page_id`=NEW.`page_id` AND `workspace_id`=NEW.`workspace_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`

				`item_count`=`item_count`+CASE WHEN
					OLD.`workspace_id` IS NOT NEW.`workspace_id` OR OLD.`page_id` IS NOT NEW.`page_id`
					THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

				JOIN `leafen_pages` AS `pages` ON `pages`.`id`=`counts`.`page_id`

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_page_kind_export_arrive`
		AFTER UPDATE OF `data_source_id` ON `leafen_pages`
		WHEN OLD.`data_source_id` != '' AND NEW.`data_source_id` = '' BEGIN
			INSERT OR REPLACE INTO `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
				(`page_id`, `workspace_id`, `owner`, `item_count`, `document_streams`)
			SELECT NEW.`id`, NEW.`workspace`, NEW.`owner`,
				1 + CASE WHEN `streams`.`count` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_blocks` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_data_sources` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_views` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_properties` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_rows` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_comments` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`),
				`streams`.`count`
			FROM (SELECT
				(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_ygo_documents` WHERE `room` = NEW.`id`)
				+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_ygo_structural_documents` WHERE `room` = NEW.`id`) AS `count`
			) AS `streams`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + COALESCE((
				SELECT `item_count` FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`id`
			), 0)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND NEW.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspaces`
					WHERE `id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`);
		END

		AFTER DELETE ON `leafen_block_trash_tombstones` BEGIN

			WHERE `object_kind`='row_block' AND `workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id`

		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_workspace_export_count_leafen_block_trash_tombstones_DELETE`
		AFTER DELETE ON `leafen_block_trash_tombstones`
		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			WHERE `page_id`=OLD.`page_id` AND `workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id`
				AND `owner`=OLD.`owner_id`
		)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` SET `item_count`=`item_count`-1
			WHERE `page_id`=OLD.`page_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count`=`item_count`-1
			WHERE `workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id` AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_pages` `pages`
				JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id`=`pages`.`workspace`
				WHERE `pages`.`id`=OLD.`page_id` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging`=FALSE
					AND `pages`.`workspace`=OLD.`workspace_id` AND `pages`.`owner`=OLD.`owner_id`
					AND `workspaces`.`owner`=OLD.`owner_id`
			);
		END

		AFTER UPDATE OF `workspace_id`,`owner_id`,`page_id` ON `leafen_block_trash_tombstones`
		WHEN OLD.`workspace_id` IS NOT NEW.`workspace_id`
			OR OLD.`owner_id` IS NOT NEW.`owner_id` OR OLD.`page_id` IS NOT NEW.`page_id`
		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count`=`item_count`-1
			WHERE `workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id` AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` `counts`
				JOIN `leafen_pages` `pages` ON `pages`.`id`=`counts`.`page_id`
				JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id`=`counts`.`workspace_id`
				WHERE `counts`.`page_id`=OLD.`page_id` AND `counts`.`workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id`
					AND `counts`.`owner`=OLD.`owner_id` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging`=FALSE
					AND `workspaces`.`owner`=OLD.`owner_id`
			);
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` SET `item_count`=`item_count`-1
			WHERE `page_id`=OLD.`page_id` AND `workspace_id`=OLD.`workspace_id` AND `owner`=OLD.`owner_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` SET `item_count`=`item_count`+1
			WHERE `page_id`=NEW.`page_id` AND `workspace_id`=NEW.`workspace_id` AND `owner`=NEW.`owner_id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count`=`item_count`+1
			WHERE `workspace_id`=NEW.`workspace_id` AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` `counts`
				JOIN `leafen_pages` `pages` ON `pages`.`id`=`counts`.`page_id`
				JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `workspaces` ON `workspaces`.`id`=`counts`.`workspace_id`
				WHERE `counts`.`page_id`=NEW.`page_id` AND `counts`.`workspace_id`=NEW.`workspace_id`
					AND `counts`.`owner`=NEW.`owner_id` AND `pages`.`notion_import_staging`=FALSE
					AND `workspaces`.`owner`=NEW.`owner_id`
			);
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_workspace_export_count_pages_INSERT` AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_pages`
		WHEN NEW.`data_source_id` = ''
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
				(`page_id`, `workspace_id`, `owner`, `item_count`, `document_streams`)
			SELECT NEW.`id`, NEW.`workspace`, NEW.`owner`,
				1 + CASE WHEN `streams`.`count` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_blocks` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_data_sources` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_views` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_properties` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_rows` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
					
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_comments` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`),
				MIN(`streams`.`count`, 2)
			FROM (SELECT
				(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_ygo_documents` WHERE `room` = NEW.`id`)
				+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_ygo_structural_documents` WHERE `room` = NEW.`id`) AS `count`
			) AS `streams`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions` SET `item_count` = `item_count` + COALESCE((
				SELECT `item_count` FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`id`
			), 0)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND NEW.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspaces`
					WHERE `id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`);
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_workspace_export_count_pages_UPDATE`
		AFTER UPDATE OF `workspace`, `owner`, `notion_import_staging` ON `leafen_pages`
		WHEN NEW.`data_source_id` = '' AND (OLD.`workspace` IS NOT NEW.`workspace`
			OR OLD.`owner` IS NOT NEW.`owner`
			OR OLD.`notion_import_staging` IS NOT NEW.`notion_import_staging`)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` - COALESCE((
				SELECT `item_count` FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` WHERE `page_id` = OLD.`id`
			), 0)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = OLD.`workspace` AND OLD.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspaces`
					WHERE `id` = OLD.`workspace` AND `owner` = OLD.`owner`);
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts`
			SET `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace`, `owner` = NEW.`owner`,
				`item_count` = CASE
					WHEN OLD.`workspace` = NEW.`workspace` AND OLD.`owner` = NEW.`owner` THEN `item_count`
					ELSE 1
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_blocks` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_data_sources` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_views` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_properties` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_database_rows` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						
						+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `leafen_comments` WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `page_id` = NEW.`id`)
						+ CASE WHEN `document_streams` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
				END
			WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`id`;
			UPDATE `leafen_workspace_content_revisions`
			SET `item_count` = `item_count` + COALESCE((
				SELECT `item_count` FROM `leafen_workspace_export_page_counts` WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`id`
			), 0)
			WHERE `workspace_id` = NEW.`workspace` AND NEW.`notion_import_staging` = FALSE
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_workspaces`
					WHERE `id` = NEW.`workspace` AND `owner` = NEW.`owner`);
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_pages_private_owner_insert`
		AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_pages`
		WHEN NEW.`teamspace_id` = '' AND NEW.`private_owner_id` = '' BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_pages` SET `private_owner_id` = COALESCE(CASE
		WHEN NEW.`teamspace_id` != '' THEN ''
		WHEN NEW.`data_source_id` != '' THEN (
			SELECT `container`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_data_sources` AS `source`
			JOIN `leafen_pages` AS `container` ON `container`.`id` = `source`.`page_id`
			WHERE `source`.`id` = NEW.`data_source_id`)
		WHEN NEW.`parent_id` = '' THEN CASE WHEN NEW.`private_owner_id` != ''
			THEN NEW.`private_owner_id` ELSE NEW.`created_by` END
		ELSE (SELECT `parent`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_pages` AS `parent`
			WHERE `parent`.`id` = NEW.`parent_id`)
	END, '')
			WHERE `id` = NEW.`id`;
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_pages_private_owner_place`
		AFTER UPDATE OF `parent_id`, `teamspace_id`, `data_source_id` ON `leafen_pages`
		WHEN OLD.`private_owner_id` IS NEW.`private_owner_id` BEGIN
			UPDATE `leafen_pages` SET `private_owner_id` = COALESCE(CASE
		WHEN NEW.`teamspace_id` != '' THEN ''
		WHEN NEW.`data_source_id` != '' THEN (
			SELECT `container`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_data_sources` AS `source`
			JOIN `leafen_pages` AS `container` ON `container`.`id` = `source`.`page_id`
			WHERE `source`.`id` = NEW.`data_source_id`)
		WHEN NEW.`parent_id` = '' THEN CASE WHEN NEW.`private_owner_id` != ''
			THEN NEW.`private_owner_id` ELSE NEW.`created_by` END
		ELSE (SELECT `parent`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_pages` AS `parent`
			WHERE `parent`.`id` = NEW.`parent_id`)
	END, '')
			WHERE `id` = NEW.`id` AND `private_owner_id` != COALESCE(CASE
		WHEN NEW.`teamspace_id` != '' THEN ''
		WHEN NEW.`data_source_id` != '' THEN (
			SELECT `container`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_data_sources` AS `source`
			JOIN `leafen_pages` AS `container` ON `container`.`id` = `source`.`page_id`
			WHERE `source`.`id` = NEW.`data_source_id`)
		WHEN NEW.`parent_id` = '' THEN CASE WHEN NEW.`private_owner_id` != ''
			THEN NEW.`private_owner_id` ELSE NEW.`created_by` END
		ELSE (SELECT `parent`.`private_owner_id` FROM `leafen_pages` AS `parent`
			WHERE `parent`.`id` = NEW.`parent_id`)
	END, '');
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_page_history_callout_icon_references_INSERT`
		AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_page_history_block_spans`
		WHEN NEW.`type` = 'callout' AND (CASE WHEN NEW.`type` = 'callout' AND json_valid(NEW.`content`)
		AND json_extract(NEW.`content`, '$.iconType') = 'image'
		AND json_type(NEW.`content`, '$.icon') = 'text'

		THEN trim(json_extract(NEW.`content`, '$.icon')) END) IS NOT NULL
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_pages` WHERE `id` = NEW.`page_id`)
		BEGIN
			INSERT OR IGNORE INTO `leafen_file_references`
				(`workspace_id`,`page_id`,`owner_kind`,`owner_id`,`property_id`,`file_id`)
			VALUES (NEW.`workspace_id`, NEW.`page_id`, 'page_history', NEW.`block_id` || ':' || NEW.`valid_from`, '',
				(CASE WHEN NEW.`type` = 'callout' AND json_valid(NEW.`content`)
		AND json_extract(NEW.`content`, '$.iconType') = 'image'
		AND json_type(NEW.`content`, '$.icon') = 'text'
		AND length(trim(json_extract(NEW.`content`, '$.icon'))) = 15
		THEN trim(json_extract(NEW.`content`, '$.icon')) END));
		END

		SELECT NEW.`id`, NEW.`owner`, NEW.`workspace_id`, NEW.`title`,
			'', 0, 0, NEW.`data_source_id`, NEW.`data_source_id`, 'data_source', 0, FALSE,
			(CASE WHEN (trim(NEW.`icon`) GLOB 'custom_emoji:[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]')
		THEN substr(trim(NEW.`icon`), 14) ELSE NEW.`icon` END), (CASE WHEN NEW.`icon` = '' THEN 'none'

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_wiki_verification_value_insert`
		AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_database_row_values` WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_database_rows` AS `verification_row`
		JOIN `leafen_data_sources` AS `verification_source`
			ON `verification_source`.`id` = `verification_row`.`data_source_id`
		WHERE `verification_row`.`id` = NEW.`row_id`
			AND `verification_source`.`wiki_verification_property_id` != ''
			AND `verification_source`.`wiki_verification_property_id` = NEW.`property_id`) BEGIN
		UPDATE `leafen_wiki_verification_queue`
		SET `status` = 'cancelled', `lease_token` = '', `lease_until` = 0,
			`completed_at` = CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER), `updated_at` = CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
		WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`row_id` AND `data_source_id` = '' AND `status` NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'failed');
		UPDATE `leafen_wiki_verification_email_deliveries`
		SET `status` = 'cancelled', `lease_token` = '', `lease_until` = 0, `updated_at` = CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
		WHERE `page_id` = NEW.`row_id` AND `data_source_id` = '' AND `status` NOT IN ('sent', 'skipped', 'failed', 'cancelled');
		UPDATE `leafen_pages`
		SET `wiki_verification_generation` = `wiki_verification_generation` + 1,
			`verified_at` = CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.state') = 'verified' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.date.start'), '') ELSE '' END,
			`verified_by` = CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.state') = 'verified' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.verified_by'), '') ELSE '' END,
			`verification_expires_at` = CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.state') = 'verified' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.`value`, '$.date.end'), '') ELSE '' END
		WHERE `id` = NEW.`row_id`;

			(`page_id`, `generation`, `workspace_id`, `due_at`, `status`, `attempts`, `next_attempt_at`,
			 `lease_token`, `lease_until`, `error_code`, `expired_at`, `completed_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`)
		SELECT `page`.`id`, `page`.`wiki_verification_generation`, `page`.`workspace`,

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_page_list_changes_page_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `leafen_pages` WHEN (NEW.`title` IS NOT OLD.`title` OR NEW.`icon` IS NOT OLD.`icon` OR NEW.`icon_type` IS NOT OLD.`icon_type` OR NEW.`parent_id` IS NOT OLD.`parent_id` OR NEW.`parent_type` IS NOT OLD.`parent_type` OR NEW.`position` IS NOT OLD.`position` OR NEW.`in_trash` IS NOT OLD.`in_trash` OR NEW.`trashed_at` IS NOT OLD.`trashed_at` OR NEW.`archived_at` IS NOT OLD.`archived_at` OR NEW.`teamspace_id` IS NOT OLD.`teamspace_id` OR NEW.`private_owner_id` IS NOT OLD.`private_owner_id` OR NEW.`kind` IS NOT OLD.`kind` OR NEW.`is_wiki` IS NOT OLD.`is_wiki` OR NEW.`data_source_id` IS NOT OLD.`data_source_id` OR NEW.`workspace` IS NOT OLD.`workspace` OR NEW.`notion_import_staging` IS NOT OLD.`notion_import_staging` OR NEW.`database_template` IS NOT OLD.`database_template` OR NEW.`deletion_job_id` IS NOT OLD.`deletion_job_id` OR NEW.`title_spans` IS NOT OLD.`title_spans` OR NEW.`is_locked` IS NOT OLD.`is_locked` OR NEW.`locked_by` IS NOT OLD.`locked_by` OR NEW.`duplication_target_job_id` IS NOT OLD.`duplication_target_job_id`) AND ((NEW.`data_source_id` = '' OR EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_data_sources` WHERE `id` = NEW.`data_source_id` AND `wiki` = 1)) OR (OLD.`data_source_id` = '' OR EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_data_sources` WHERE `id` = OLD.`data_source_id` AND `wiki` = 1))) BEGIN
				UPDATE `leafen_page_list_change_sequence` SET `seq` = `seq` + 1 WHERE `singleton` = 'pages';
		INSERT INTO `leafen_page_list_changes` (`workspace_id`, `page_id`, `seq`, `subtree_seq`)
		SELECT `changed_workspace`.`id`, NEW.`id`, `sequence`.`seq`,
			CASE WHEN NEW.`parent_id` IS NOT OLD.`parent_id` OR NEW.`deletion_job_id` IS NOT OLD.`deletion_job_id` THEN `sequence`.`seq` ELSE 0 END
		FROM `leafen_page_list_change_sequence` `sequence`
		JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `changed_workspace` ON `changed_workspace`.`id` = NEW.`workspace`
			AND `changed_workspace`.`deletion_job_id` = ''
		WHERE `sequence`.`singleton` = 'pages' AND NEW.`id` IS NOT NULL AND (1)
		ON CONFLICT (`workspace_id`, `page_id`) DO UPDATE SET
			`seq` = excluded.`seq`, `subtree_seq` = MAX(`subtree_seq`, excluded.`subtree_seq`);UPDATE `leafen_page_list_change_sequence` SET `seq` = `seq` + 1 WHERE `singleton` = 'pages';
		INSERT INTO `leafen_page_list_changes` (`workspace_id`, `page_id`, `seq`, `subtree_seq`)
		SELECT `changed_workspace`.`id`, OLD.`id`, `sequence`.`seq`,
			CASE WHEN 1 THEN `sequence`.`seq` ELSE 0 END
		FROM `leafen_page_list_change_sequence` `sequence`
		JOIN `leafen_workspaces` `changed_workspace` ON `changed_workspace`.`id` = OLD.`workspace`
			AND `changed_workspace`.`deletion_job_id` = ''
		WHERE `sequence`.`singleton` = 'pages' AND OLD.`id` IS NOT NULL AND (OLD.`workspace` IS NOT NEW.`workspace`)

			`seq` = excluded.`seq`, `subtree_seq` = MAX(`subtree_seq`, excluded.`subtree_seq`);
