CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_public_share_graph_source_page`
		AFTER UPDATE OF `page_id` ON `leafen_data_sources`
		WHEN OLD.`page_id` IS NOT NEW.`page_id` BEGIN
			INSERT INTO `leafen_public_share_graph_jobs` (`share_link_id`, `page_id`, `queued_at`)
			SELECT `member`.`share_link_id`, `row`.`id`, unixepoch('subsec')*1000
			FROM `leafen_database_rows` `row`
			JOIN `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships` `member`
				ON `member`.`page_id` IN (`row`.`id`, OLD.`page_id`, NEW.`page_id`)
			JOIN `leafen_public_share_links` `link` ON `link`.`id` = `member`.`share_link_id`
				AND `link`.`source_revision` = `member`.`source_revision` AND `link`.`enabled` = 1
			WHERE `row`.`owner` IN (OLD.`owner`, NEW.`owner`)
				AND `row`.`page_id` IN (OLD.`page_id`, NEW.`page_id`) AND `row`.`data_source_id` = NEW.`id`
			ON CONFLICT (`share_link_id`, `page_id`) DO NOTHING;
			DELETE FROM `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships`
		WHERE `page_id` IN (SELECT `row`.`id` FROM `leafen_database_rows` `row`
				WHERE `row`.`owner` IN (OLD.`owner`, NEW.`owner`)
				AND `row`.`page_id` IN (OLD.`page_id`, NEW.`page_id`) AND `row`.`data_source_id` = NEW.`id`) AND `root_page_id` != `page_id` AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships` `parent`
			WHERE `parent`.`share_link_id` = `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships`.`share_link_id`
				AND `parent`.`page_id` = (SELECT (CASE WHEN `graph_page`.`data_source_id` = '' THEN `graph_page`.`parent_id`
		ELSE COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN `ancestry_source`.`wiki` = 1
				AND COALESCE(`ancestry_row`.`subitem_parent_id`, '') != ''
				THEN `ancestry_row`.`subitem_parent_id` ELSE `ancestry_source`.`page_id` END
			FROM `leafen_data_sources` AS `ancestry_source`
			LEFT JOIN `leafen_database_rows` AS `ancestry_row` ON `ancestry_row`.`id` = `graph_page`.`id`
			WHERE `ancestry_source`.`id` = `graph_page`.`data_source_id`), '') END) FROM `leafen_pages` `graph_page`
		WHERE `graph_page`.`id` = `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships`.`page_id`)
		);
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_public_share_graph_source_trash`
		AFTER INSERT ON `leafen_database_container_trash` WHEN NEW.`kind` = 'source' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO `leafen_public_share_graph_jobs` (`share_link_id`, `page_id`, `queued_at`)
		SELECT `member`.`share_link_id`, `row`.`id`, unixepoch('subsec')*1000
		FROM `leafen_database_container_sources` `membership`
		JOIN `leafen_data_sources` `source` ON `source`.`id` = `membership`.`data_source_id`
		JOIN `leafen_database_rows` `row` ON `row`.`owner` = `source`.`owner`
			AND `row`.`page_id` = `source`.`page_id` AND `row`.`data_source_id` = `source`.`id`
		JOIN `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships` `member` ON `member`.`page_id` IN (`row`.`id`, `source`.`page_id`)
		JOIN `leafen_public_share_links` `link` ON `link`.`id` = `member`.`share_link_id`
			AND `link`.`source_revision` = `member`.`source_revision` AND `link`.`enabled` = 1
		WHERE `membership`.`container_id` = NEW.`container_id` AND `membership`.`source_container_id` = ''
		ON CONFLICT (`share_link_id`, `page_id`) DO NOTHING;
			DELETE FROM `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships`
			WHERE `root_page_id` != `page_id` AND `page_id` IN (
				SELECT `row`.`id` FROM `leafen_database_container_sources` `membership`
		JOIN `leafen_data_sources` `source` ON `source`.`id` = `membership`.`data_source_id`
		JOIN `leafen_database_rows` `row` ON `row`.`owner` = `source`.`owner`
			AND `row`.`page_id` = `source`.`page_id` AND `row`.`data_source_id` = `source`.`id`
				WHERE `membership`.`container_id` = NEW.`container_id` AND `membership`.`source_container_id` = '');
		END

CREATE TRIGGER `leafen_public_share_graph_source_restore`
		AFTER DELETE ON `leafen_database_container_trash` WHEN OLD.`kind` = 'source' BEGIN
			INSERT INTO `leafen_public_share_graph_jobs` (`share_link_id`, `page_id`, `queued_at`)
		SELECT `member`.`share_link_id`, `row`.`id`, unixepoch('subsec')*1000
		FROM `leafen_database_container_sources` `membership`
		JOIN `leafen_data_sources` `source` ON `source`.`id` = `membership`.`data_source_id`
		JOIN `leafen_database_rows` `row` ON `row`.`owner` = `source`.`owner`
			AND `row`.`page_id` = `source`.`page_id` AND `row`.`data_source_id` = `source`.`id`
		JOIN `leafen_public_share_graph_memberships` `member` ON `member`.`page_id` IN (`row`.`id`, `source`.`page_id`)
		JOIN `leafen_public_share_links` `link` ON `link`.`id` = `member`.`share_link_id`
			AND `link`.`source_revision` = `member`.`source_revision` AND `link`.`enabled` = 1
		WHERE `membership`.`container_id` = OLD.`container_id` AND `membership`.`source_container_id` = ''
		ON CONFLICT (`share_link_id`, `page_id`) DO NOTHING;
		END
